name: preview-generated-formatting
goal: Generated managed preview launchers are excluded by both formatting entry points while authored source remains checked.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Commit 6a0c5def writes generated preview launchers under packages/reports/.cache. Root formatting skips caches, but package formatting lacks that declaration and the full check rejects 33 generated bundles.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing standardized format-ignore test covers only the root ignore file and old fixture outputs. Extend it to both formatter entry points, generated runtime paths and authored preview source.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Formal red c5943cb7 at 468dd3f4 proves the package formatter does not exclude generated launchers; root formatting and authored-source assertions already pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Declare only .cache in the package ignore file. Keep authored source checked. The existing root format-ignore test now checks both entry points in normal unit verification.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: ffad359f declares only the generated .cache directory in the package formatter. The existing standardized root guard runs both formatter boundaries and preserves source inclusion.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Formal green 9947baa6 at ffad359f passes the unchanged command and complete test corpus from red e12d92df at 468dd3f4.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: A clean ffad359f snapshot with only the .cache ignore removed fails the same unchanged format-ignore test. Restoring that line passes. The checkout and its source files were untouched.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: The committed format boundary pair, both formatter entry points and the isolated reintroduction guard pass. Full parent verification remains pending because the desktop browser suite has unresolved failures; see preview-auto-recovery.
